materials.name: Synthetic Silver Epoxy
materials.handling_notes: Mix for two minutes before use.
materials.storage_conditions: Store refrigerated according to the test procedure.

defect_rules.possible_cause: Synthetic test pressure is below the qualified setting
defect_rules.reasoning: The synthetic procedure links continuous low volume to insufficient pressure.

troubleshooting_actions.cause: Synthetic test pressure is below the qualified setting
troubleshooting_actions.action: Compare pressure with the synthetic qualified recipe.
troubleshooting_actions.safety_notes: Do not exceed the synthetic process window.
